question: When was the master direction of RBI on microfinance loans implemented?
solution:
The correct answer is __**April 01, 2022**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) issued the **Master Direction on Regulatory Framework for Microfinance Loans**, which came into effect on **April 01, 2022**.
 
• The new regulatory framework aims to **standardize rules across all lenders** providing microfinance loans, including banks, NBFCs, and MFIs.
 
• It introduces a **common definition of microfinance loans**, removing the distinction between NBFC-MFIs and other lenders.
 
• Under this framework, **interest rate ceilings** on microfinance loans were removed, allowing lenders to determine rates transparently.
 
• The framework focuses on reducing **over-indebtedness** by capping the total loan repayment obligation of a household at 50% of its monthly income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microfinance Loans:**

 
 
• These are small-ticket loans provided to low-income individuals or groups who lack access to traditional banking services.
 
• Typically used for income-generating activities, microfinance loans aim to promote **financial inclusion**.
 
 
 
• **NBFC-MFIs:**
 
 
• Non-Banking Financial Companies-Microfinance Institutions primarily focus on providing microfinance loans to economically weaker sections.
 
• They were earlier subject to regulatory norms specific to the microfinance sector, such as interest rate caps.
 
 
 
• **Household Income Assessment:**
 
 
• As per the new framework, lenders must assess the household income of borrowers to ensure that loan repayments do not exceed 50% of income.
 
• This aims to prevent **over-indebtedness** and improve borrower financial health.
 
 
 
• **Transparency in Interest Rates:**
 
 
• The RBI now mandates lenders to disclose a comprehensive pricing structure, including interest rates, processing fees, and insurance charges.
 
• This is aimed at ensuring **transparency and fairness** for borrowers.
 
 
 
• **Financial Inclusion:**
 
 
• The Master Direction is a step forward in promoting financial inclusion by creating a level playing field for all microfinance lenders.
 
• It focuses on empowering borrowers through **responsible lending practices**.
